query: 水风险评估 水风险评估 衡量企业识别、评估和管理水风险的体系成熟度。 内容质量得分 (取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：使用了专业风险识别工具（如 WRI Aqueduct），具备水压力情景分析，有针对高风险站点的应对措施，且建立了水资源治理机制（如首席水官或专项考核）。 • 1分（合格）：有基础的水风险识别和定性描述，具备通用性应对措施（如节水计划），但缺乏针对性工具应用或深度的情景评估。 • 0分（不合格）：无水风险评估披露，或仅笼统提及“重视水资源保护”。 水风险评估 水压力 基准水压力 水资源短缺 干旱风险 洪涝风险 流域风险 高水压力地区 高风险站点 水压力情景分析 WRI Aqueduct WWF水风险过滤器 water risk assessment water stress baseline water stress water scarcity drought risk flood risk basin risk high water stress areas high-risk sites water stress scenario WRI Aqueduct WWF Water Risk Filter 企业是否使用专业水风险工具（如WRI Aqueduct）识别水风险？ 是否按流域、运营点或高水压力区域开展评估？ 是否包含水压力情景分析？ 对高风险站点采取了哪些针对性应对措施？ 是否建立水资源治理机制（如专项职责或考核）？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '水风险评估'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 企业是否使用专业水风险工具（如WRI Aqueduct）识别水风险？ 是否按流域、运营点或高水压力区域开展评估？ 是否包含水压力情景分析？ 对高风险站点采取了哪些针对性应对措施？ 是否建立水资源治理机制（如专项职责或考核）？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有笼统“重视节水”；仅有用水效益目标而无风险评估；仅有排污合规数据；仅有社区饮水公益项目；区分：水风险评估关注风险识别工具、情景与高风险站点应对；用水效益目标与行动方案关注节水量化目标及工程/管理措施，二者不可互相替代。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.section: Environmental, Social and Governance Report 2021 環境、社會及管治報告 2021 / Reduction of Environmental Footprint
results.text: 'Environmental Protection' is a traditional part of China SCE's 'Walk for Good' event. This year, together with China SCE's 4 th 'Walk for Good', China SCE's public welfare initiated the 'Environmental Partnerships, Speak Up for the Earth'. Over 800 team members and staff used their own water bottles throughout the 11 stops across the country, refusing to use bottled water or canned sports drinks. At the same time, the team members worked together to simulate various environmental protection symbols and spread them to their friends on social media to let more people understand environmental protection knowledge. They also used biodegradable garbage bags to collect recyclable garbage for a demonstration of recycling at the end point. The measures above make the concepts of 'Low-carbon Green' and 'Traceless Travel' have a real impact on everyone.

[Content]
'Environmental Protection' is a traditional part of China SCE's 'Walk for Good' event. This year, together with China SCE's 4 th 'Walk for Good', China SCE's public welfare initiated the 'Environmental Partnerships, Speak Up for the Earth'. Over 800 team members and staff used their own water bottles throughout the 11 stops across the country, refusing to use bottled water or canned sports drinks. At the same time, the team members worked together to simulate various environmental protection symbols and spread them to their friends on social media to let more people understand environmental protection knowledge. They also used biodegradable garbage bags to collect recyclable garbage for a demonstration of recycling at the end point. The measures above make the concepts of 'Low-carbon Green' and 'Traceless Travel' have a real impact on everyone.

The Board will also continue to enhance its involvement in ESG work, maintain regular meetings with management and review progress and effectiveness in order to establish a top-down governance model.

A shared vision of development is a prerequisite for the formation of trusting and win-win partnerships and alliances, including the pursuit of sustainable development. Currently, the Group has regarded environmental protection risk and social and governance risk of suppliers as one of the criteria for the review of supplier cooperation, and standardised management is carried out to more effectively reduce the negative impact of the supply chain on the Group's operation. In addition, the Group encourages contractors and subcontractors to use more eco-friendly equipment and facilities, as well as adopt new eco-friendly technologies, hoping to prevent pollution and reduce resource utilisation together with the construction unit during the construction stage, so as to reduce the impact on the environment.
